summary: Turns the search page into a client component that reads q from the URL, fetches matching products and lists them.

findings.title: URL query rendered as raw HTML
findings.problem: The heading injects the q URL parameter into the page as raw HTML. Nothing sanitizes or escapes the query first.
findings.consequence: An attacker can send a crafted search link that runs script in the victim's session. This is reflected XSS.
findings.fix: Render the query as a normal text child so React escapes it.

findings.title: Effect without dependency array refetches forever
findings.problem: The effect has no dependency array, so it runs after every render. Each fetch calls setResults with a new array, which triggers another render.
findings.consequence: The page sends search requests to the catalog API in an endless loop. This wastes client and server resources.
findings.fix: Pass [query] as the dependency array so the effect runs only when the query changes.

findings.title: Hooks called after a conditional return
findings.problem: SearchPage returns early when q is empty, before it calls useState and useEffect. The number of hooks then changes between renders.
findings.consequence: React throws a hooks mismatch error when q goes from empty to non-empty on client navigation. The page crashes.
findings.fix: Call useState and useEffect before any early return. Skip the fetch inside the effect when query is empty.

findings.title: Search form removed with no replacement
findings.problem: The change deletes the form and input that let users enter a search term. The page now asks users to type a term but offers no input.
findings.consequence: Users who open the search page without q have no way to search.
findings.fix: Keep the search form on the page, both in the empty state and above the results.

findings.title: Search failure not handled
findings.problem: searchProducts throws when the response is not ok, but the promise chain has no catch. The rejection goes unhandled.
findings.consequence: Users see an empty list with no error message when the search fails. The rejection also logs as unhandled.
findings.fix: Add a catch handler that records an error state and render a message for it.

findings.title: List items rendered without a key
findings.problem: Each li built from results has no key prop. Product already has a stable id field.
findings.consequence: React logs a key warning and cannot reconcile the list efficiently when results change.
findings.fix: Set key to product.id on each li.

findings.title: New search behaviour has no covering test
findings.problem: SearchPage gained an empty state, a data fetch and a results list. No test exercises any of them.
findings.consequence: Regressions in the search page will reach users unnoticed.
findings.fix: Add a component test that covers an empty query, a successful search and a failed search.
